meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码库交给多名漏洞猎手和验证工程师并行审查,找出真正可利用的缺陷并定级。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布前想确认代码里没有被忽视的可利用漏洞。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm exploitable flaws before shipping.

howto.what: 它会拉起一个 5 人团队(3 名漏洞猎手 + 2 名 PoC 工程师)并行审计代码库,用最小 PoC 验证漏洞是否真能被利用,按实际可利用性定级,最后给出 PASS / BLOCK 等结论的报告。
howto.when: 当你提到 “security-research”“vulnerability audit” 等关键词,或要求做发布前安全检查、威胁模型验证时触发;也能用 /security-research 调用。

say.text: 用 security-research 审计当前仓库和当前分支,给出结论。
say.note: 没给目标时默认审当前仓库与分支 diff

say.text: 对这个 PR 的改动做可利用性审计,只留有攻击路径的发现。
say.note: 每个存活发现附文件路径与命令

say.text: 把这份威胁模型的假设验证一遍,没复现的请降级。
say.note: 未复现的候选会进降级或驳回清单

howto.what_en: Spins up a 5-member team (3 vulnerability hunters + 2 PoC engineers) to audit a codebase in parallel, proves exploitability with minimal PoCs, calibrates severity by exploitability, and returns a report with a PASS / BLOCK verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "security-research", "vulnerability audit" and similar keywords, or ask for a pre-release security check or threat model validation; also runs via /security-research.

say_en.text: Run security-research on this repo and current branch, and give the verdict.
say_en.note: Defaults to the current repo when no target is given

say_en.text: Audit exploitability of this PR's diff; keep only findings with an attack path.
say_en.note: Each surviving finding lists file paths and commands

say_en.text: Validate this threat model's assumptions; downgrade anything not reproduced.
say_en.note: Unreproduced candidates go to the downgraded list
